template.name: Drill (UK / NY)
template.about: Sliding 808s, triplet hats and offbeat snares at 140, dark strings and piano.

project.name: Drill (UK / NY)
project.notes:
DRILL  (Chicago c. 2011; UK drill c. 2013; NY drill c. 2019)

SOUND
Around 140 BPM in half-time (working figure, unconfirmed), triplet hats, offbeat snares,
808 bass lines that slide in big intervals, dark strings, piano and choirs.

REFERENCE GEAR (sourced)
- Chicago's DJ L used "a cracked copy of FruityLoops"; UK drill left "space for the swooping
  808 basslines"; 808Melo (Ilford) produced Pop Smoke's "Welcome to the Party" (VICE).
- Drill began in Chicago around 2011, with London versions around 2013 (Red Bull).

WORKFLOW
Program the Groove pattern (The drum rack plays one-shots synthesized for these templates (CC0, no recordings), in the voice of the machine each channel is named for, with a starter beat in the pattern; replace them with your own samples for the real machine.), then set a 1/16T pattern for triplet hats. The Sliding
808 is Surge XT "Sub 1" with a long glide (~125 ms): overlap notes to slide whole intervals.

MIX NOTES
- 808 carries the low end: kick short and quiet under it; built-in Overdrive at 12 dB.
- Strings and choir dark: Space D church with the high shelf down 4 dB.
- Master as trap: glue, Lemon Soft Clipper, Lemon Limiter at -0.5 dB; working target -7 to -6 LUFS.
- Loudness: streaming plays back near -14 LUFS integrated (Spotify), so a louder master is turned down; keep true peak below -1 dBTP.

COVERAGE
Good, with the same 808 caveat as Trap; the drums are synthesized one-shots, not samples of the machines.

SOURCES
VICE "The Secret History of Drill"; Red Bull "UK drill FAQ"; Spotify for Artists, "Loudness normalization" (support.spotify.com/us/artists/article/loudness-normalization).

FREE PLUG-INS (download them before opening the template; a missing one keeps its slot)
- Surge XT (GPL-3.0): https://surge-synthesizer.github.io/
- OB-Xf (GPL-3.0): https://github.com/surge-synthesizer/OB-Xf

SETUP (written from this template)
Tempo 142 BPM, 4/4, key C#min, cycle bars 1-4.

Tracks
- Drums (Instrument, +0 dB) -> Drum Bus
    instrument: Channel Rack (synthesized one-shots of the template samples: Kick (808) = kick-808.wav, Snare (808) = snare-808.wav, Closed Hat (808) = hat-808.wav, Open Hat (808) = openhat-808.wav, Clap (909) = clap.wav, Rim (909) = rim.wav, Snare 909 = snare-909.wav)
    strip FX: Compressor (Threshold -12, Ratio 4, Attack 30, Release 80, Make-up 2)
    region: Step Sequencer pattern with a starter beat (20 steps on), swing 50% (MPC terms), 7 rows = the rack's channels
- Sliding 808 (Instrument, -2 dB) -> Drum Bus
    instrument: Surge Synth Team: Surge XT: Surge XT patch "Basses/Sub 1"; A Play Mode 0.5, A Portamento 0.5
    strip FX: Overdrive (Drive 12, Tone 5500, Level -6)
- Strings (Instrument, -12 dB) -> Music Bus
    instrument: Surge Synth Team: OB-Xf: OB-Xf patch "Strings/Uneasy Strings"
    send: Reverb (bus 4) at -12 dB
- Piano (Instrument, -10 dB) -> Music Bus
    instrument: Surge Synth Team: OB-Xf: OB-Xf patch "Keys/Acoustic Piano 2"
    send: Reverb (bus 4) at -14 dB
- Choir (Instrument, -16 dB) -> Music Bus
    instrument: Surge Synth Team: OB-Xf: OB-Xf patch "Voices/Choir Ooh 1"
    send: Reverb (bus 4) at -10 dB
- Lead Vocal (Audio, +0 dB) -> Vocal Bus
    strip FX: Compressor (Threshold -20, Ratio 4, Attack 0.5, Release 60, Make-up 3)
    strip FX: Compressor (Threshold -22, Release 300, Make-up 3)
    send: Reverb (bus 4) at -20 dB
    send: Delay (bus 5) at -18 dB

Buses (the n-th Aux strip listens to bus n)
- Drum Bus (bus 1): Lemon Soft Clipper: default settings; Compressor (Threshold -16, Ratio 2, Attack 20, Release 300, Make-up 2)
- Music Bus (bus 2): Channel EQ (High 1.5)
- Vocal Bus (bus 3): Compressor (Release 150, Make-up 2)
- Reverb (bus 4): Space D (Dry -96, Wet 0, Decay 3.5, Decay Curve 1, Output EQ High -4, IR "Church")
- Delay (bus 5): Tape Delay (Time 140.8, Tone 5000, Mix 1)

Stereo Out
- built-in effects: Compressor (Threshold -10, Attack 30, Release 200)
- plug-ins (after the built-in effects): Lemon Soft Clipper: default settings; Lemon Limiter: gain +6 dB, ceiling -0.5 dB, other settings default

Bring your own samples: no recordings are included.
